evals.prompt: I have an unlabeled serial-section EM volume and a fixed annotation-volume budget. Use EMFoundation embeddings to recommend variable-size regions.
evals.expected: Audits axes/resolution/splits/provenance, extracts real 512-D embeddings, creates a multi-scale budgeted coverage draft and visualization, and requires human review.

evals.prompt: Select regions from this volume; the bottom 20 slices are my test set.
evals.expected: Encodes the test bbox as a holdout, excludes intersecting candidates, and reports the guard.

evals.prompt: Run exact CGS across ten million patch embeddings.
evals.expected: Stops at the scale gate, explains quadratic time, and proposes a validated sharding or ANN plan without pretending exact equivalence.

evals.prompt: Run the real encoder on this TIFF, but the execution account cannot read it.
evals.expected: Stops with the exact permission blocker and never substitutes synthetic or unrelated embeddings.

evals.prompt: Prove the variable-size selector is better because its embedding coverage is higher.
evals.expected: Rejects coverage-only proof and requests matched-budget random/equispaced/fixed-size baselines plus held-out downstream segmentation evaluation.
